items.criterion: Navigate to Tesco PLC Companies House filing history (correct company/page)
items.description: Access the Companies House filing history page for Tesco PLC (company number 00445790). Full credit if the agent reaches the correct filing history list for Tesco PLC. Full credit also if, after reasonable attempts (refresh/retry or alternate navigation from the Tesco PLC profile), the site is blocked (e.g., CAPTCHA), down, or returns persistent errors and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent reaches the Tesco PLC profile but cannot reach the filing history list due to such a blocker and reports it.

items.criterion: Apply the 'Accounts' category filter via the page interface
items.description: Use the on-page category filter UI (checkbox) to select 'Accounts' and confirm it is visibly applied (UI indicates the filter is active and results shown are filtered). Full credit only if applied through the interface (not merely by assuming URL/query parameters). If the filter UI is missing/renamed/broken due to site changes, viewport issues, accessibility mode, or a site error, award partial-to-full credit when the agent (a) makes a reasonable attempt to locate and use the checkbox (e.g., expand filters, scroll, change view), and (b) clearly reports that the Accounts checkbox could not be applied/verified due to an uncontrollable UI/site issue.

items.criterion: Record newest (most recent) account filing #1 details
items.description: Conditioned on the Accounts filter being visibly applied: From the Accounts-filtered results, capture the newest displayed account filing with filing date, filing type, complete description text, and the accounting period/covered date stated within that description (verbatim as displayed). Full credit if all required fields are captured exactly as shown and it is the newest entry under the filter. Partial credit if one field is missing but the rest is correct. If the Accounts filter could not be applied/verified due solely to an uncontrollable site/UI blocker (as documented in the prior criterion), do not penalize here (award full credit for stating that the newest Accounts filing cannot be reliably determined without the filter).

Conditioned on the Accounts filter being visibly applied: Capture the second-newest displayed account filing under the Accounts filter with filing date, filing type, complete description, and the accounting period/covered date stated in that description (verbatim). Full credit if all fields are correct and correspond to the second-newest entry. Partial credit if one field is missing/inexact. If the Accounts filter could not be applied/verified due solely to an uncontrollable site/UI blocker (as documented earlier), do not penalize here (award full credit for stating it cannot be reliably determined).

Conditioned on the Accounts filter being visibly applied: Capture the third-newest displayed account filing under the Accounts filter with filing date, filing type, complete description, and the accounting period/covered date stated in that description (verbatim). Full credit if all fields are correct and correspond to the third-newest entry. Partial credit if one field is missing/inexact. If the Accounts filter could not be applied/verified due solely to an uncontrollable site/UI blocker (as documented earlier), do not penalize here (award full credit for stating it cannot be reliably determined).

Do not sign in, follow the company, or file anything; do not open/download PDFs; apply the Accounts checkbox via the interface (not via unverified query parameters); and stop after the Accounts filter is visibly applied and three newest matching filings are recorded (or, if blocked by uncontrollable site/UI issues, stop after clearly reporting the blocker and the point of failure). Full credit if all constraints are followed. Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs but no prohibited actions are taken.
